comments.author: Seperallis
comments.body:
"Traditional Russian Cuisine"

Obtained from the Shopkeeper in St. Petersburg with Adept of Age(18 Century-P.3) title equipped.
The book contains recipes for the following:

Baba
Red Turnip Salad
Pelmeni
Russian Style Potato Salad
Russian Style Meatball (required for memorial album)
Gorsok
Borscht
Cod Cream Stew
Recipes range from Cooking r6 to r12.

Nothing super exciting unless you're Dutch, in which case you can quickly stockpile ingredients for both Cod Cream Stew (fatigue, vigor+60) & the potato salad (scurvy, vigor+40) by bouncing between Helder and Rotterdam, with a quick jaunt to the cod fisheries north of Bremen. Maybe add Antwerp to the route and make Edam Gratin at the same time for three okay vigor foods on your mid-adventure pit-stop.

Additionally, the meatballs are required for completing memorial album World Rice Dishes
